title: Croatian Chicken Pilaf
description: A flavorful Indian-inspired pilaf dish made with Croatian chicken and warm spices. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken to the saucepan and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove chicken from the saucepan and set aside.
Add basmati rice to the saucepan and cook for 1 minute.
Add water, Croatian paprika, garam masala, and salt to the saucepan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in the cooked chicken.
